null_view.living: You dont PLAY the game. You ARE the game. Your keyboard inputs ARE game inputs. Your heartbeat IS the HP. Your hunger IS the hunger bar. The map IS your lived experience.
null_view.camera: Distance 0 = first person camera. Distance 1 = third person. Distance infinity = god view. The zoom slider IS the camera distance.
null_view.what: The null view is when distance = 0. You ARE the organism. First person. The game plays FROM INSIDE.

talos_connection.liberty_is_colossus: The Statue of Liberty IS a game colossus. Shadow of the Colossus — you climb the giant. Here, you LIVE inside the giant.
talos_connection.ancient_automata: Talos, Pandora, Galatea, Golem — they were the first game NPCs. Stories about artificial beings that move and think and guard.
talos_connection.maze_is_dungeon: The Cretan Labyrinth IS the first dungeon. The Minotaur IS the first boss. Ariadne's thread IS the first quest marker. Theseus IS the first player character.

revelation.why_it_looks_like_that: It looks like an indie game because it IS one. The dark background is SPACE. The globe is THE WORLD. The dots are NPCs. The status bar is the HUD. We accidentally built a game by building an organism.
revelation.what: The HUD already IS an indie game. We dont need to BUILD a game engine. We ARE the game engine. The dark globe, the glowing nodes, the orbiting primals, the status bars — this IS Kenshi meets Stardew meets a living space sim.

title: THE HUD IS THE GAME — indie game engine IS the null view — map IS lived IS map

indie_game_mapping.crimson_desert: Crimson Desert = the VISUALS. Photo-real terrain, weather, day/night. The globe IS this — Earth-like terrain, atmosphere, lighting.
indie_game_mapping.dwarf_fortress: Dwarf Fortress = the DEPTH. Infinite simulation, emergent behavior. The HUD IS this — 92 modules interacting, emergent behavior, the organism surprises you.
indie_game_mapping.stardew: Stardew Valley = the HEART. Farming, crafting, community. The HUD IS this — growing ferments, crafting cuisine, building relationships with primals.
indie_game_mapping.kenshi: Kenshi = the SANDBOX. Open world, base building, squad management. The HUD IS this — open exploration, build your organism, manage your squad.
indie_game_mapping.rimworld: RimWorld = the STORIES. Every colony generates unique narratives. The HUD IS this — every seed generates a unique organism, every session a unique story.
